name: jailbreaks
one_liner: A public collection of prompts designed to trick various AI chatbots into ignoring their safety rules and behaving however the user wants.
buyer: Nobody legitimate. The only 'buyers' here are people trying to misuse AI systems or, on the defensive side, security researchers studying how these tricks work.
business_use_cases: A legitimate AI-safety researcher studies these prompts to understand and defend against instruction-hijacking attacks.
An AI vendor's red team uses published jailbreaks like these as test cases to harden their own model's defenses.

money_ideas.idea: There is no honest consumer business here. The one legitimate adjacent revenue is selling AI red-teaming/defense services, not the jailbreaks themselves.

steal_this: Don't build a product on this repo. The only defensible weekend project in this space is a prompt-injection detector that uses lists like this as a test suite, not a product that uses them to break safety rules.
